gold_decisions.identity_explanation: Both identify that the localized nearest-image cutoff does not reach the vertical-boundary endpoints, so the nearest reflected kernel remains in the remainder and the required whole-boundary exponential operator estimate is unsupported.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The cutoff/support assumptions fail to include the endpoint-near nearest reflected interaction, invalidating exponential smallness of the separated remainder and the dependent Neumann-series argument.

component_coverage.gold_component: The open PML cutoff excludes the vertical-boundary endpoints, leaving the nearest reflected kernel and a non-separated boundary-boundary interaction in the remainder; consequently the all-boundary exponential estimate and dependent Neumann-series arguments are unsupported.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-002 explicitly identifies the absence of an all-boundary operator-norm estimate, the factor left by the cutoff near endpoints, its O(1) endpoint behavior, the resulting failure of the Neumann-series step, and the specific repair requiring the cutoff to equal one near the vertical boundaries.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: Both identify that the computable-field convergence claim is stated for compact subsets of the full truncated region, while the supporting PDE convergence estimate and physical/PML comparison apply only to compact subsets of the physical domain.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The theorem overextends a physical-domain convergence estimate to compact sets in the PML region, where the physical solution is not exponentially close to the PML solution; the estimate must be restricted to the physical domain.

component_coverage.gold_component: The computable-field estimate is claimed on every compact subset of Ω_R although the exact PML-PDE estimate is only established on compact subsets of Ω_p, with no argument extending the comparison into the PML layer.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-003 explains why the physical solution is not exponentially close in the PML layer, notes that the invoked convergence results are proved only for K contained in Ω_p, and identifies the resulting false field-convergence claim on the PML part of Ω_R.

component_coverage.gold_component: The adequate repair is to restrict K to compact subsets of Ω_p while retaining the physical-domain conclusions.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-003 gives the matching repair: replace K contained in Ω_R by K contained in Ω_p in both statements.
